title.en: Resistivity of materials and its temperature dependence
title.kn: ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ರೋಧಶೀಲತೆ ಮತ್ತು ತಾಪದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅದರ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ

heading.en: A cold bulb and a hot bulb

hook.en: Measure the resistance of a cold 60 W filament bulb and you get less than 100 ohm. When it glows on 230 V its resistance is close to 900 ohm. Temperature changes resistance.
hook.kn: ತಣ್ಣನೆಯ 60 W ಬಲ್ಬ್‌ನ ರೋಧ 100 ಓಮ್‌ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ. 230 V ನಲ್ಲಿ ಉರಿಯುವಾಗ ಅದು ಸುಮಾರು 900 ಓಮ್ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ತಾಪವು ರೋಧವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Measure the resistance of a cold 60 W filament bulb and you get less than 100 ohm. When it glows on 230 V its resistance is close to 900 ohm. Temperature changes resistance.
narration.kn: ತಣ್ಣನೆಯ 60 W ಬಲ್ಬ್‌ನ ರೋಧ 100 ಓಮ್‌ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ. 230 V ನಲ್ಲಿ ಉರಿಯುವಾಗ ಅದು ಸುಮಾರು 900 ಓಮ್ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ತಾಪವು ರೋಧವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: For metals resistivity rises with temperature, nearly linearly: $\rho_T = \rho_0[1 + \alpha(T - T_0)]$, α being the temperature coefficient of resistivity (copper: about 4 × 10⁻³ °C⁻¹). Hotter ions vibrate more, collisions are more frequent and τ falls. Alloys such as nichrome and manganin have high ρ and very small α, so they are used for heating elements and standard resistors. In semiconductors ρ falls as T rises, because the number of carriers n increases. Insulators have very large ρ.
body.kn: ಲೋಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಾಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಂತೆ ರೋಧಶೀಲತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ: ρ_T = ρ₀[1 + α(T − T₀)]. ಮ್ಯಾಂಗನಿನ್‌ನಂತಹ ಮಿಶ್ರಲೋಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ α ಬಹಳ ಕಡಿಮೆ. ಅರೆವಾಹಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಾಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಂತೆ ರೋಧಶೀಲತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Metals: ρ increases with T (α positive)

narration.en: In metals, resistivity rises with temperature because collisions become more frequent. Alloys like manganin hardly change, so they make standard resistors. In semiconductors resistivity falls as temperature rises because more charge carriers are freed.
narration.kn: ಲೋಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಾಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಂತೆ ರೋಧಶೀಲತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ: ρ_T = ρ₀[1 + α(T − T₀)]. ಮ್ಯಾಂಗನಿನ್‌ನಂತಹ ಮಿಶ್ರಲೋಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ α ಬಹಳ ಕಡಿಮೆ. ಅರೆವಾಹಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಾಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಂತೆ ರೋಧಶೀಲತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: resistivity and temperature

narration.en: Resistivities span a huge range: about 10⁻⁸ ohm metre for metals, and above 10¹⁰ for insulators. For metals ρ rises almost linearly with temperature: ρ_T = ρ₀[1 + α(T − T₀)]. In a semiconductor ρ falls as it warms, because more charge carriers are set free. Example: 2.1 Ω at 27 °C and 2.7 Ω at 100 °C give α = 0.6 over 2.1 × 73, about 3.9 × 10⁻³ per degree. Ohm's law fails for devices like a diode: its V–I graph is curved and depends on the direction of V.

say.en: Resistivities span a huge range: about 10⁻⁸ ohm metre for metals, and above 10¹⁰ for insulators.
For metals ρ rises almost linearly with temperature: ρ_T = ρ₀[1 + α(T − T₀)].
In a semiconductor ρ falls as it warms, because more charge carriers are set free.
Example: 2.1 Ω at 27 °C and 2.7 Ω at 100 °C give α = 0.6 over 2.1 × 73, about 3.9 × 10⁻³ per degree.
Ohm's law fails for devices like a diode: its V–I graph is curved and depends on the direction of V.

body.en: Ohm's law is not a universal law. Some devices are non-ohmic: (a) V is not proportional to I (a lamp filament as it heats up); (b) the current depends on the sign of V, not just its size (a p-n junction diode); (c) the same current occurs at more than one voltage (GaAs).
body.kn: ಓಮ್ ನಿಯಮ ಸಾರ್ವತ್ರಿಕವಲ್ಲ. ಉರಿಯುವ ತಂತು, ಡಯೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು GaAs ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ V ಮತ್ತು I ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Depends on the sign of V (diode)
Same I at more than one V (GaAs)

narration.en: Ohm's law is not universal. A glowing filament, a diode, and gallium arsenide are examples where V and I are not simply proportional.
narration.kn: ಓಮ್ ನಿಯಮ ಸಾರ್ವತ್ರಿಕವಲ್ಲ. ಉರಿಯುವ ತಂತು, ಡಯೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು GaAs ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ V ಮತ್ತು I ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

title.en: Resistance of a metal wire versus temperature

caption.en: R = R₀[1 + α(T − 20 °C)] for a metal wire. α is in units of 10⁻³ per °C; copper is about 3.9.

tryThis.en: Set R₀ = 2.1 Ω, α = 3.9, T = 100 °C: R ≈ 2.76 Ω, close to the 2.7 Ω of the example.
Double α: the line gets twice as steep.
How hot must a copper wire get for its resistance to double?

narration.en: R = R₀[1 + α(T − 20 °C)] for a metal wire. α is in units of 10⁻³ per °C; copper is about 3.9. Set R₀ = 2.1 Ω, α = 3.9, T = 100 °C: R ≈ 2.76 Ω, close to the 2.7 Ω of the example. Double α: the line gets twice as steep. How hot must a copper wire get for its resistance to double?

aim.en: To find the resistance of a given wire using a metre bridge and hence the resistivity of its material.

narration.en: Put the wire in one gap and a known resistance in the other, slide the jockey to the null point, and use the balance condition to find the wire's resistance. Then measure its length and diameter to get the resistivity.

problem.en: A silver wire has a resistance of 2.1 Ω at 27.5 °C and 2.7 Ω at 100 °C. Find the temperature coefficient of resistivity of silver.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A silver wire has a resistance of 2.1 Ω at 27.5 °C and 2.7 Ω at 100 °C. Find the temperature coefficient of resistivity of silver.

problem.en: A nichrome heater on 230 V draws 3.2 A when first switched on at 27 °C and 2.8 A when steady. α for nichrome is 1.70 × 10⁻⁴ °C⁻¹. Find the steady temperature.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A nichrome heater on 230 V draws 3.2 A when first switched on at 27 °C and 2.8 A when steady. α for nichrome is 1.70 × 10⁻⁴ °C⁻¹. Find the steady temperature.

points.en: Metals: ρ rises with T; semiconductors: ρ falls with T.
points.kn: ಲೋಹಗಳು: ತಾಪದೊಂದಿಗೆ ρ ಹೆಚ್ಚು; ಅರೆವಾಹಕಗಳು: ρ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

points.en: Alloys like manganin have tiny α: used for standard resistors.
points.kn: ಮ್ಯಾಂಗನಿನ್‌ನಂತಹ ಮಿಶ್ರಲೋಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ α ಅತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ: ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ರೋಧಕಗಳಿಗೆ ಬಳಕೆ.

points.en: Ohm's law fails for diodes, filaments and GaAs.
points.kn: ಡಯೋಡ್, ತಂತು ಮತ್ತು GaAs ಗಳಿಗೆ ಓಮ್ ನಿಯಮ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

homework.en: A platinum resistance thermometer reads 2.0 Ω at 0 °C and 2.6 Ω at 100 °C. Find the temperature when it reads 2.3 Ω.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ρ_T = ρ₀[1 + α(T − T₀)]. ಲೋಹಗಳು: ತಾಪದೊಂದಿಗೆ ρ ಹೆಚ್ಚು; ಅರೆವಾಹಕಗಳು: ρ ಕಡಿಮೆ. ಮ್ಯಾಂಗನಿನ್‌ನಂತಹ ಮಿಶ್ರಲೋಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ α ಅತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ: ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ರೋಧಕಗಳಿಗೆ ಬಳಕೆ. ಡಯೋಡ್, ತಂತು ಮತ್ತು GaAs ಗಳಿಗೆ ಓಮ್ ನಿಯಮ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
